title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Harap ng Jeepney — Luna's storefront painted like the front of a jeepney, fares and all. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Harap ng Jeepney
options.lineage: hand-painted jeepney signboards and fare boards, Magallanes
options.thesis: The storefront painted like the front of a jeepney: destination, fares, and the price board in one enamel panel.
options.viewport: Painted wordmark on enamel, the fare rail live on the right, the price board running underneath.
options.risk: Sign-painter lettering collapses into generic poster type the moment the bevel goes soft.

raised.raise: Emphasis is scale, rotation and outline weight — never a colour change.
The fare rail is a real instrument: a needle that leans, keyed to distance, never a decorative slider.
Content banded into painted courses, each line's measure matching its band.

options.label: Resibo
options.lineage: thermal delivery receipts and carbon-copy order pads
options.thesis: The page is the receipt from your last delivery: itemised, priced, torn along the top.
options.viewport: One narrow strip of paper on a dark counter, the order already itemised.
options.risk: The receipt is a known trick on café sites, and one narrow strip wastes a desktop viewport.

options.label: Hand-Bent Neon
options.lineage: hand-bent neon sign circuits, one continuous gas-discharge tube
options.thesis: The shopfront as a lit sign: one continuous bent tube naming the place after dark.
options.viewport: A dark street, the wordmark bent in cobalt tube, prices in lit strips beneath.
options.risk: Neon is a loud world that flatters any brand; the tube can outshine the food.
options.case: Fuses well on recognition — a lit sign is what a hungry customer looks for at night — but the tube cannot price a delivery, so the mechanism stays outside it.

options.label: Cereal Aisle
options.lineage: supermarket planogram wall of cereal facings
options.thesis: The menu as a shelf: every dish a facing at eye height with its price shouting.
options.viewport: Six facings on a shelf rail, burst violators on what is new, a torn price flag on the side.
options.risk: Packaged-goods language promises a boxed product Luna does not sell.
options.case: Fuses well on clarity — a facing with a price reads instantly — but the aisle belongs to supermarkets, not to a kiosk in Purok 5.

options.label: Telop Caption Field
options.thesis: Every line lands as a hand-placed outlined caption sized to how much it matters.
options.viewport: Outlined captions scattered over the frame, the biggest one naming tonight's bestseller.
options.risk: A caption field is a frame for someone talking; it prices nothing.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the voice transfers, the surface does not.
options.kept: Emphasis by scale, rotation and outline weight, never by colour.

options.label: Risograph Inks
options.thesis: Warm paper ground, two fluorescent inks slightly out of register, grain over everything.
options.viewport: Flat fluoro shapes over paper, the ink layers a hair off alignment.
options.risk: Print-shop romance; a hungry customer reads it as a zine, not a menu.
options.case: Fuses poorly: lovely craft, no identification for a delivery order.
options.kept: Depth from a deliberately misregistered second layer, not from shadow.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.thesis: A row of ballistic needles behind glass that lean into the red together.
options.viewport: Twenty meter faces shoulder to shoulder, all needles asleep against the pins.
options.risk: Studio equipment; the needles measure sound, not pesos.
options.case: Fuses poorly: one brilliant instrument, wrong room.
options.kept: A needle with real mass and damping — animation that obeys ballistics.

options.label: Coiled Earth Tower
options.thesis: A tower of clay courses where each band carries one part of the offer.
options.viewport: Terracotta coils rising past the fold, thumb-smoothed seams catching the light.
options.risk: Reads as craft pottery, not as a kitchen you can order from tonight.
options.case: Fuses poorly: magnificent material, but the product disappears inside it.
options.kept: Content banded into courses, each line's measure matching its band.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What food brands ship: hero photo, three feature cards, a testimonial strip.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, product photo right, three equal cards underneath.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other kiosk page by design.
